title: Identity compatibility on the complete tensor Roos complex
statement: For prime l, finite E/Q_l and W with l invertible, let D be an identity completion datum [def-pod-completion-reindex-models] and T its tensor datum [def-pod-completion-tensor-reindex-models]. Suppose QuotientGenerators, Generators, RoosFst and RoosSnd, and let a be the section-normalized ordinary identity. For good P,Q, the Roos reindexing map followed by Roos(T.tower) and the tensor-complex map of the two degreewise a maps equals the degreewise a map on the original tensor Roos complex. This is an equality of entire cochain maps.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5: identity and composition of the normalized quotient, Roos-limit and tensor transport.

proof.text: Apply podIdentityTensorTower. Functoriality of Roos identifies the strict tower part of the composite. Apply podIdentityRoosMap with the two coordinate laws of D to identify the entire Roos map, including its shifted coordinate.

mathlib_searches.query: A map of mapping cones is determined by both coordinate projections and naturality of products under an isomorphism to the identity functor
mathlib_searches.results: Found mappingCone.ext_to and ext_to_iff, map and mapHomologicalComplexXIso_eq. These give coordinate extensionality, not the section-normalized identity on these strict coefficient towers.

theorem podIdentityTensorRoos
    (W : Scheme.{u}) [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E (𝟙 W))
    (hg : PodCompletionReindex.QuotientGenerators l E (𝟙 W) D)
    (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E (𝟙 W) D)
    (ht : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Generators l E (𝟙 W) D T)
    (hf : PodCompletionReindex.RoosFst l E (𝟙 W) D)
    (hs : PodCompletionReindex.RoosSnd l E (𝟙 W) D)
    (a : isoReductionIntegralInverse l E (𝟙 W) ≅ 𝟭 _)
    (ha : ∀ (M : scalarReductionSource l E W) (U : W.ProEt)
      (x : M.val.obj (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose (𝟙 W)).obj U))),
      (a.hom.app M).val.app (op U) x =
        M.val.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.mapId (P := @WeaklyEtale) ⊤ W
          (𝟙 W) rfl).hom.app U).op x)
    (P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory) :
    let α := NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex a (.up ℤ) ≪≫
      Functor.mapHomologicalComplexIdIso _ (.up ℤ)
    (D.roos ((integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E W).obj (P.obj, Q.obj))).hom ≫
      integralOperationsRoosFunctor.map (T.tower P Q).hom ≫
      (integralOperationsTensorComplexFunctor l E W).map
        (Prod.mkHom (α.hom.app P.obj) (α.hom.app Q.obj)) =
      α.hom.app ((integralOperationsTensorComplexFunctor l E W).obj (P.obj, Q.obj))
